ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota and follow the money to uncover the root causes of the problem.
questions: What are the root causes of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How can the state prevent future cases of fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in the Medicaid system, and could lead to significant reforms and accountability.

ideas.title: The Trump Administration's War on Federal Funding
ideas.description: Investigate the Trump administration's efforts to freeze federal funding for various programs and projects, and explore the potential consequences of these actions.
questions: What programs and projects have been affected by the funding freeze?
What are the potential consequences of these actions?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on the Trump administration's priorities and policies, and could lead to a better understanding of the impact of these actions on various communities and industries.
